'''Carl Jenner If The Rancor Doesn't Eat You The Sarlscc Will''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Carl Jenner]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-22048">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/22048 If The Rancor Doesn't Eat You The Sarlscc Will], DeckTech (carl "jode" jenner, 11 March 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/22048/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/22048/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Carl Jenner]]
* '''Published:''' 11 March 2002 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''If The Rancor Doesn't Eat You The Sarlscc Will''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Strategy:''' This was one of my first deck's I ever did but I have tweacked it since.

== Original post ==

'''If The Rancor Doesn't Eat You The Sarlscc Will'''
* '''Author:''' carl "jode" jenner
* '''Published:''' March 11, 2002
* '''Rating:''' 2.0
* '''Description:''' This was one of my first deck's I ever did but I have tweacked it since.

=== Strategy ===

I pull out Tatooine docking bay with the Objective and Bib fortuna with Power of the hutt.I use the game text from Jabba's audience chamber to pull out Chall bekan then I use his game text to get Mercenary pilot. I deplie a Disruptor  pistall on Mercenary pilot I depile Bib fortuna and Mighty jabba.
